verdict.rationale: YPOG has a named 'IP/IT/Data Protection' practice page, suggesting some data-protection capability, but the evidence provided only describes it in terms of building/realizing IP assets for VC/PE deals — there is no mention of GDPR, CCPA, DPDP Act, or any documented compliance-counseling work product (e.g., DPIAs, breach response, cross-border transfer advice). Missing for 10: explicit GDPR/CCPA/DPDP compliance advisory descriptions, named privacy/cyber practice leadership or client matters, any breach-response or regulatory-inquiry track record.
